race.comment: PURPLE HAZE (2) has been nothing if not consistent in his career to date. It was a much deserved win at Taree. Perhaps that coincided with getting out in ground. He goes out another 150m into this event. Easy to say he can just repeat that effort. KURITHEA (6) will be bred to run this right out. She has been a bit up and down but the best of those runs has put her into the placings. TACITLY (3) should be running similarly to all his recent outings. Well drawn but keeps finding one better. WHOOPI DO (8) won't be the odds of her maiden win but has found her consistency so can place.
